items.title: Corpse Reviver Cocktail
items.author: Elsie Larson
items.description: The Corpse Reviver No. 2 is a pre-Prohibition cocktail recipe created to be so strong that it could revive your hungover corpse. Originally, it was served as a morning drink. This cocktail is both equal parts sweet and strong with a hint of bitterness. Can it really cure hangovers? We’ll let you be the judge…
